source_brief.standout: A row of walking poses lights in sequence, turning the layout itself into a giant flipbook.
source_brief.scene: A playful nighttime LED parade avenue in cyan, gold and violet. Six ORIGINAL simple friendly humanoid puppet contour frames show successive walking poses on separate grounded bays along a dark path. In hero only ONE pose glows brightly, the neighboring frames are dim silhouettes, making the layout an addressable walking flipbook. Bottom four storyboard cells show consecutive lit walking poses traveling left to right, one frame active at a time.
